panel.intro: With one account you can use the service personally and work in your organization. The two sides stay separate.

person.heading: Sign in with a code sent by email or WhatsApp.

points.first: As a person, in your personal profile.
points.second: In your organization, with the access your role grants you.
points.third: No passwords: sign in with a code by email or WhatsApp.

business.heading: Your group and all its companies in one place.

points.first: All the companies in your group in one place.
points.second: Users with roles by organization and company.
points.third: A record of who did what and when.
